newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane Fran takes aim at South Carolina.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Fran takes aim at South Carolina.

text.p: Hurricane Fran and its 115 mph winds (185 km) bore down on the South Carolina coastline Thursday morning, and forecasters at National Hurricane Center cautioned that the storm could grow stronger.
At 0800 EDT/1200 GMT, Fran was about 215 miles (345 km) southeast of Charleston, at latitude 30.8 north and longitude 77.2 west.
Forecasters predicted the storm would probably come ashore between Charleston and Myrtle Beach, S.C.
Gale-force winds were expected to begin slapping the coastline at lunchtime, and the hurricane-force winds that extend outward up to 145 miles (230 km) could strike by late evening, forecasters said.
Fran picked up a little speed during the night and was moving north-northwest at 14 mph (22 kmh).
Rainfall of up to 10 inches was predicted along Fran's path.
